scope: Whole archived guide and pinned HTML; source interpretation, not human/server verification

1.original_instruction: Enter the building at the center of the St. Capitolina Abbey (prt_monk 192, 171), and greet the elderly man there (monk_test 316, 68). Next, a 3 o'clock from here, outside the building, you should see an NPC "Apprentice Monk" (prt_monk 270, 197). If you talk to him with 0 Weight, he will teach you Spiritual Bestowment .
1.short_ru: Посетите elderly man, затем Apprentice Monk (prt_monk 270, 197) при 0 Weight, чтобы изучить Spiritual Bestowment.
1.short_en: Visit the elderly man, then Apprentice Monk (prt_monk 270, 197) at 0 Weight to learn Spiritual Bestowment.
1.full_ru: Войдите в центральное здание St. Capitolina Abbey (prt_monk 192, 171) и поприветствуйте elderly man (monk_test 316, 68). Затем справа, в направлении 3 часов, снаружи здания найдите Apprentice Monk (prt_monk 270, 197). Если поговорить с ним при 0 Weight, он обучит вас Spiritual Bestowment.
1.full_en: Enter the building at the center of the St. Capitolina Abbey (prt_monk 192, 171), and greet the elderly man there (monk_test 316, 68). Next, a 3 o'clock from here, outside the building, you should see an NPC "Apprentice Monk" (prt_monk 270, 197). If you talk to him with 0 Weight, he will teach you Spiritual Bestowment .

requirements.condition: At the Apprentice Monk teaching interaction only, not the separate Excruciating Palm materials.

2.original_instruction: Head to the old man (monk_test 316, 68) in the center building of the St. Capitolina Abbey (prt_monk 192, 171). He requires two things before he will teach you the skill.
2.short_ru: У old man в monk_test 316, 68 узнайте условия Excruciating Palm.
2.short_en: Ask the old man at monk_test 316, 68 about Excruciating Palm requirements.
2.full_ru: Идите к old man (monk_test 316, 68) в центральном здании St. Capitolina Abbey (prt_monk 192, 171). Прежде чем обучить вас умению, он потребует выполнить два условия. Предварительное условие: завершить Spiritual Bestowment Quest.
2.full_en: Head to the old man (monk_test 316, 68) in the center building of the St. Capitolina Abbey (prt_monk 192, 171). He requires two things before he will teach you the skill. Quest Prerequisite(s): Completed Spiritual Bestowment Quest

requirements.evidence: Quest Prerequisite(s): Completed Spiritual Bestowment Quest

3.original_instruction: First, you must learn Spiritual Bestowment , and second, you must gather items dropped by Mandragoras . Return to the man with 20 Stems and 3 Shoots , and he will then teach you Excruciating Palm .
3.short_ru: Изучив Spiritual Bestowment, принесите 20 Stems и 3 Shoots для Excruciating Palm.
3.short_en: After learning Spiritual Bestowment, bring 20 Stems and 3 Shoots for Excruciating Palm.
3.full_ru: Сначала изучите Spiritual Bestowment, затем соберите предметы, выпадающие с Mandragoras. Принесите этому человеку 20 Stems и 3 Shoots: он обучит вас Excruciating Palm.
3.full_en: First, you must learn Spiritual Bestowment , and second, you must gather items dropped by Mandragoras . Return to the man with 20 Stems and 3 Shoots , and he will then teach you Excruciating Palm .

reviews.detail: Zero Weight applies only when Apprentice Monk teaches Spiritual Bestowment; it cannot apply to the material-carrying Excruciating Palm activity. The latter needs the earlier skill, not this whole guide completed before itself. No Job Level is printed and none is invented.

Elderly man/old man are the same actor by the identical interior point in this guide. The entrance 192,171 and interior 316,68 remain distinct and ordered; the job guide prints entrance 192,170, which is not silently normalized. The unnamed elder is not merged with Tomoon solely by location.

routes.condition: Spiritual Bestowment training. Exact zero Weight applies at the Apprentice Monk interaction only.
Excruciating Palm training requires learned Spiritual Bestowment, then the material set. Do not apply zero Weight to this hand-in.
